## Skills

::: {.skills-grid}

**Quantitative Analysis:** Experimental design, causal inference, econometrics, survey methodology, policy and impact evaluation

**Programming & Data Tools:** R, Python, SQL, Stata, Excel, Git

**Structured Problem-Solving:** Evidence synthesis, meta-analysis, analytical framework development for complex policy questions

**Presentation & Reporting:** PowerPoint, LaTeX, Quarto, publication-quality data visualisation

**Communication:** Academic publishing, technical writing, teaching and facilitation, stakeholder briefings

**Languages:** Cebuano (second-most-spoken Philippine language)

:::
